contract.unit_of_observation: Monthly active B2B SaaS account snapshot (account_id, observation_date) recorded at 00:00:00 UTC on the first calendar day of each month.
contract.target_definition: Binary indicator (1 = churned, 0 = retained). Equals 1 if and only if an account that is ACTIVE at observation_date experiences voluntary subscription cancellation or involuntary non-payment termination within (observation_date, observation_date + 90 days].
contract.censoring_and_missing_outcome_policy: Snapshots whose 90-day outcome window extends past dataset_cutoff_date (2025-06-30) have right-censored outcomes (is_censored_outcome = True, churned_within_90d = NaN). Censored snapshots are preserved in raw lineage storage for auditing and strictly excluded from supervised train, validation and test partitions prior to modelling.
contract.intended_deployment_population: Active commercial B2B SaaS customer accounts with at least 30 days of subscription tenure at the monthly scoring timestamp.
contract.primary_protocol: Protocol B: Future-Period Prediction (Chronological Split with 90-Day Outcome-Window Purging)
contract.secondary_protocol: Protocol A: New-Account Generalisation (Disjoint Account-Group Partitioning)

snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
snapshot_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the account-month observation row.

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.description: Unique customer organisation identifier across longitudinal snapshots.

outcome_window_end.name: outcome_window_end
outcome_window_end.description: End date of the 90-day forward churn observation window (observation_date + 90 days).

dataset_cutoff_date.name: dataset_cutoff_date
dataset_cutoff_date.description: Global data extraction cutoff date (2025-06-30) determining outcome censoring.

account_status_at_obs.name: account_status_at_obs
account_status_at_obs.description: Account subscription state at observation_date (must be ACTIVE for eligible cohort).

row_hash.name: row_hash
row_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical snapshot values for provenance tracking.

mrr_gbp.name: mrr_gbp
mrr_gbp.description: Contracted Monthly Recurring Revenue in GBP at observation_date.

seats_purchased.name: seats_purchased
seats_purchased.description: Number of licensed user seats active on the subscription at observation_date.

tenure_months.name: tenure_months
tenure_months.description: Completed months elapsed since initial paid subscription activation.

discount_pct.name: discount_pct
discount_pct.description: Commercial discount percentage applied to the active subscription.

active_seats_ratio_30d.name: active_seats_ratio_30d
active_seats_ratio_30d.description: Ratio of distinct active users in [t_obs - 30d, t_obs] to seats_purchased.

usage_events_30d.name: usage_events_30d
usage_events_30d.description: Total core workflow events logged by the account in [t_obs - 30d, t_obs].

usage_trend_90d_pct.name: usage_trend_90d_pct
usage_trend_90d_pct.description: Percentage change in 30d usage volume relative to the prior 60-90d baseline.
usage_trend_90d_pct.missingness_mechanism: Missing when tenure_months < 3 or telemetry backfill incomplete (~6% missing).

api_error_rate_30d.name: api_error_rate_30d
api_error_rate_30d.description: Fraction of customer API/webhook requests returning 4xx/5xx errors in trailing 30d.

feature_adoption_score.name: feature_adoption_score
feature_adoption_score.description: Composite adoption score [0, 100] across sticky platform integrations at t_obs.

days_since_last_admin_login.name: days_since_last_admin_login
days_since_last_admin_login.description: Days elapsed between the most recent workspace administrator login and t_obs.

support_tickets_30d.name: support_tickets_30d
support_tickets_30d.description: Count of customer support tickets opened in [t_obs - 30d, t_obs].

urgent_tickets_90d.name: urgent_tickets_90d
urgent_tickets_90d.description: Count of Severity-1/2 escalation tickets opened in [t_obs - 90d, t_obs].

mean_first_response_hours.name: mean_first_response_hours
mean_first_response_hours.description: Average support first-response latency (hours) over trailing 90d.
mean_first_response_hours.missingness_mechanism: Structurally missing when zero support tickets occurred in trailing 90d (~18% missing).

csat_trailing_90d.name: csat_trailing_90d
csat_trailing_90d.description: Mean customer satisfaction score [1.0, 5.0] from surveys completed on or before t_obs.
csat_trailing_90d.missingness_mechanism: Structurally missing when customer submitted no CSAT survey in trailing 90d (~28% missing).

late_payments_12m.name: late_payments_12m
late_payments_12m.description: Count of invoices settled more than 7 days past due in [t_obs - 365d, t_obs].

dunning_events_6m.name: dunning_events_6m
dunning_events_6m.description: Automated payment retry/dunning sequences triggered in [t_obs - 180d, t_obs].

contract_type.name: contract_type
contract_type.description: Billing renewal cycle structure at observation_date.

industry_sector.name: industry_sector
industry_sector.missingness_mechanism: Occasionally unrecorded for self-serve signups (~3% missing).
industry_sector.expected_domain: FinTech | HealthTech | Logistics | ECommerce | DevTools | ProfessionalServices

company_size_band.name: company_size_band
company_size_band.description: Employee headcount bracket recorded at onboarding/enrichment.
company_size_band.missingness_mechanism: Missing when firmographic enrichment is unavailable (~2.5% missing).

payment_method.name: payment_method
payment_method.description: Primary payment instrument configured at observation_date.

churned_within_90d.name: churned_within_90d
churned_within_90d.description: Binary outcome: 1 if subscription terminated in (t_obs, t_obs + 90d], 0 otherwise (NaN if right-censored).

contract.synthetic_disclosure: Synthetic Benchmark Disclosure: This dataset is deterministically generated from a documented longitudinal B2B SaaS simulation (SEED=20261105). Because the synthetic generator and evaluation pipelines share authorship, reported metrics demonstrate pipeline mechanics, temporal/group boundary enforcement and leakage-audit sensitivity. They do not constitute an independent real-world benchmark or commercial client outcome.
